name: io.github.beer-sakthai/sak-family-agent
title: SakThai Agent
description: A personal learning agent with durable SQLite memory. Exposes memory capture, recall, search, session search and cross-persona delegation as MCP tools, backed by a store that persists across sessions.

packageArguments.description: Serve the memory tools over MCP stdio.

environmentVariables.name: SAKTHAI_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Data directory holding the memory database, sessions and extensions.

environmentVariables.name: SAKTHAI_SHELL_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Any non-empty value enables the run_command tool, which is otherwise refused. Leave unset unless you mean it.

environmentVariables.name: SAKTHAI_MAIL_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Recipients send_outlook_mail may write to, as addresses or @domain, comma or space separated. Unset denies every recipient.

environmentVariables.name: SAKTHAI_EXPERIMENTAL
environmentVariables.description: Offer draft-track MCP extensions, currently MCP Apps (io.modelcontextprotocol/ui) and its ui:// views.
